description: This image displays a two-level sunburst or multi-level pie chart representing a hierarchical categorization of tasks or instructions, showing both broad categories and specific subcategories with associated numerical values. The chart consists of an inner ring with 3 broad categories and an outer ring divided into 9 specific subcategories. The inner ring includes "Contradiction Resolution" colored in reddish-brown, "Context Tracking" in dark blue, and "Context Retrieving" in dark green, with these labels written directly inside the segments. The outer ring's slices are color-coded to match their corresponding inner parent category. Adjacent to "Contradiction Resolution" are three reddish-brown slices labeled "Prioritization" (100), "Personalization" (100), and "Privacy Protection" (111). Next to "Context Tracking" are three blue slices labeled "Triggering" (100), "Recursive Reasoning" (110), and "Dynamic Environment" (100). Bordering "Context Retrieving" are three green slices labeled "Memorization" (100), "Dynamic Instruction" (100), and "Multitasking" (160). The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, the outer subcategory labels and their numerical values are positioned outside the chart and connected to their respective slices by thin lines. The sizes of the outer slices correspond to their numerical values, with "Multitasking" being visibly the largest segment, though the slices are not arranged in a strict ascending or descending order. Additionally, a small empty circular space is present at the very center of the chart.
